question:
Select the most appropriate option that can best replace the bracketed word to fill in the blank

His ________ stature was not a measure of his overall personality. (scrawny)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"scrawny"** means unattractively thin and bony. (दुबला-पतला)

 
 
• **Example: **The scrawny cat looked like it hadn't eaten in days.
 
 
 
• **"Thin"** refers to having little, or too little, flesh or fat on the body. (पतला)
 
 
• **Example: **He was tall and thin, with a serious expression on his face.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word "thin" is a suitable replacement for "scrawny".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sickly** (अस्वस्थ): Often ill; in poor health.

 
 
• **Example:** The sickly child had to stay home from school.
 
 
 
• **Keen** (तेज): Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** She was keen to start her new job.
 
 
 
• **Muscular** (मांसल): Having well-developed muscles.
 
 
• **Example:** The muscular athlete won the weightlifting competition.
